info.title: What is HollyPolly?
info.description: HollyPolly is a real-time application that lets you draw lots and create random teams with your friends.
info.step1: 1. Create a room and share it with your friends (You can share directly using the Share Draw Room button)
info.step2: 2. Add options (e.g., who cooks, who cleans)
info.step3: 3. Use Winner/Loser buttons or Create Random Teams
info.step4: 4. Result is shown to everyone at the same time!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: HollyPolly ("we", "our", or "the app") is a real-time lot-drawing and random team creation application. We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.nameText: You voluntarily enter a name to join a room. This name is stored temporarily in a Firestore session document and is automatically deleted when the room is closed. We do not link it to any account or persistent identity.
s1.roomText: Options and participant lists you create are stored in Firebase Firestore only for the duration of your session.
s1.adText: If you use the iOS or Android app, Google AdMob may collect your device's advertising identifier (IDFA / GAID) and usage data to serve relevant ads. This occurs only after you grant permission via Apple's App Tracking Transparency (ATT) prompt.
s1.analyticsText: Firebase may collect anonymised crash and performance data to help us improve the app.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.item1: To provide real-time room functionality via Firebase Firestore.
s2.item2: To display your chosen name to other participants in the same room.
s2.item3: To serve ads through Google AdMob (mobile apps only). AdMob may use your advertising identifier for personalised ads if you grant ATT permission, or serve non-personalised ads if you decline.
s2.item4: To monitor app stability through Firebase Crashlytics / Performance.

s3.title: 3. Data Sharing
s3.intro: We do not sell your personal data. Data may be shared with:
s3.googleText: for Firestore real-time database, authentication, and analytics services. See
s3.admobText: for ad serving in the mobile app. See

s4.title: 4. App Tracking Transparency (iOS)
s4.p2: key because Google AdMob may request permission to track you across apps. When you open the app for the first time, iOS will display Apple's standard ATT permission dialog. Selecting
s4.p4: results in non-personalised ads. Either choice does not affect core app functionality.

s5.title: 5. Data Retention
s5.text: Room data (names, options) is deleted from Firestore when the room is closed or automatically after 24 hours of inactivity. We do not maintain any long-term user database.

s6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
s6.text: HollyPolly is rated 4+ and is suitable for all ages. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided personal information, please contact us so we can delete it.

s7.title: 7. Your Rights
s7.text: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete any personal data we hold. Because we store no persistent user accounts, most data is already automatically ephemeral. For any requests, contact us at the address below.

s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
s8.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the new policy.
